# Pinned upstream demo fixtures

AnvilWiki v2.37.0, commit 8172383d4ee58d062f1e987007ea062e90cc745c, MIT.

Only template demo data is preserved here. It is not a site content collection and is never published. Generic rewriter code is imported from the live project; demo marker and reset tests read this fixture rather than incorrectly requiring a branded fork to contain demo articles.
